name: Car Drawing App with AR Trace

android.desc:
Use your phone as an AR drawing canvas to trace & sketch cars, bikes, and other vehicles onto paper. Car Drawing App with AR helps you practice auto drawing from clear templates, whether you are a beginner learning basic shapes or an automotive fan refining detailed designs.

Explore Auto Sketching
• Practice drawing high-performance vehicles, sleek supercars, rugged sport bikes, and classic cruisers.
• Trace aerodynamic lines, bold body shapes, wheels, frames, and other vehicle details.
• Sketch modern race cars, classic vehicles, choppers, and off-road motorcycles.
• Build confidence with a drawing experience designed for gearheads, automotive fans, and everyday artists.

Guided Car Tutorials
• Follow step-by-step lessons that take you from basic shapes to more detailed car sketches.
• Learn how to sketch vehicle forms in a clear, approachable way.
• Practice drawing the structure and style of different cars while developing your own technique.
• Use guided instructions to trace each part at your pace and create a finished drawing.

Two Ways to Trace and Sketch
• AR Projector Mode: Place your phone on a glass surface or stand, choose a vehicle template, and view the projected image through your screen.
• Trace the car template directly onto paper while the camera helps you keep the proportions and lines in place.
• Screen Tracing Mode: Use your phone screen as a reference while you draw and trace your selected design on paper.
• Switch between modes to find a comfortable way to practice drawing cars, bikes, and classic vehicles.

Draw the Vehicles You Like
• Supercars and sports cars: Practice the smooth, aerodynamic shapes of fast modern designs.
• Motorcycles and bikes: Sketch sport bikes, choppers, and off-road motorcycles with distinctive frames and details.
• Classic vehicles: Explore timeless car shapes and vintage-inspired cruiser designs.
• Every template gives you a focused subject for drawing, tracing, and improving your sketching skills.

Made for Artists and Auto Fans
Car Drawing App with AR turns your camera into a practical reference tool for paper drawing. Use it to practice, trace, and sketch vehicles with more control, then return to the same subjects as your skills grow. From a first car outline to a carefully finished drawing, the app gives you a simple way to enjoy vehicle art wherever you draw.

Start sketching today and practice tracing cars, supercars, bikes, and classic vehicles on paper.
